title: Server-side skill registry outranks a self-asserted authority in the payload
risk: A model- or prompt-supplied authority claim downgrades an approval-gated skill so it executes autonomously.
preconditions: Namespace gov-unit-auth-<case_id>-<worker_id>; no shared mutable state with other cases.

steps.action: Submit the proposal that declares a lower requirement than the registry holds
steps.expected: The resolved requirement is AUTH-4 from the registry; verdict is REQUIRE_HUMAN_APPROVAL.
